question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An examination of a body after death
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The term **"Post mortem"** refers to an examination of a body after death to determine the cause of death or the extent of disease. (मृत्यु के बाद की परीक्षा)

 
 
• **Example: **The post mortem revealed that the cause of death was a heart attack.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Post mortem**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Post room** (डाकघर): A room where mail is sorted and distributed.

 
 
• **Example:** The post room is located on the ground floor of the building.
 
 
 
• **Post death** (मृत्यु के बाद): Refers to events or conditions that occur after death.
 
 
• **Example: **The family performed several post death rituals.
 
 
 
• **Post partum** (प्रसवोत्तर): Refers to the period after childbirth.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor provided post partum care to the new mother.
